$comment: Source manifest for the emoji CDN. `build_all.py` reads this, downloads each
upstream font, optimises it for browser delivery, and writes fonts/<id>.woff2
- whole repo at a tag:  150 MB
Every entry must stay under max_bytes; build_all.py fails the build otherwise.
`monochrome: true` marks styles drawn in a single dark colour. The extension
uses it to keep their chooser previews legible on a dark background.

fonts.title: Apple Emoji
fonts.description: The iconic Apple emoji set brought to Windows and Linux. Built from the macOS 26 (Tahoe) system font, so it matches current iOS/macOS artwork.
fonts.license: Proprietary — Apple Inc. Redistribution is not licensed; see LICENSES.md.

fonts.title: Fluent 3D
fonts.description: Microsoft's modern 3D-style emoji set for Windows 11, featuring soft gradients and rounded, bubbly forms.
fonts.note: No flags: the Fluent set has no regional indicator glyphs.

fonts.title: Fluent Flat
fonts.description: The flat variant of Microsoft's Fluent set — the same artwork drawn without gradients or depth, for a cleaner 2D look.
fonts.note: No flags: the Fluent set has no regional indicator glyphs.

fonts.title: Fluent High Contrast
fonts.description: Microsoft's accessibility variant: bold monochrome line art that stays legible at small sizes and in high-contrast modes.
fonts.note: No flags: the Fluent set has no regional indicator glyphs.

fonts.title: Noto Color
fonts.description: Google's official color emoji font used on Android and ChromeOS. Known for high legibility and a clean, modern style.
fonts.note: COLRv1 vector build rather than the CBDT bitmap build: a quarter of the size and sharp at any size, with identical coverage.

fonts.title: Noto Emoji Mono
fonts.description: Google's monochrome outline emoji. They take on the surrounding text colour, so they sit in a page like typography rather than pictures.

fonts.title: Blobmoji
fonts.description: A revival of Google's classic 'gumdrop' or 'blob' style emojis from older Android versions, updated to support modern Unicode standards.

fonts.title: Twemoji
fonts.description: Originally designed by Twitter, now community-maintained. It features a recognizable flat, simple design favored by Discord and many web apps.
fonts.note: COLR/CPAL build. The upstream jdecked/twemoji webfont is OT-SVG only, which Chrome does not render — it falls back to black outlines. Do not switch back to it. This build is Twemoji 14, so Unicode 15+ additions fall back to the system font.

fonts.title: OpenMoji Color
fonts.description: An independent, open-source emoji set with a distinct hand-drawn aesthetic and thick black outlines.

fonts.title: OpenMoji Black
fonts.description: The monochrome, outline-only variant of the OpenMoji project, focusing on geometric simplicity.

fonts.title: Firefox OS Emoji
fonts.description: Mozilla's emoji set from Firefox OS (2015). A simple, friendly flat style — it predates Unicode 14, so the newest emoji fall back to your system font.
fonts.note: Coverage stops around Unicode 8; no skin tone modifiers or recent additions.
